issues: 底图是压暗的六格 FakeDashboard，卡片里全是 14–20px 的小字与骨架条，飞线连接的两张卡读不出是什么指标
飞线从卡中心画到卡中心，盖在内容上面；匀速感的 out-cubic 生长，没有"打过去"的速度与重量
落点只是描边亮一下，数据本身没有任何变化，"指标关联"停留在装饰层
f86 后整段死帧 54f，画面完全静止
changes: look 换成 ember（暖黑 · 熔橙 · 金），画面改成为镜头设计的"归因图"：三张 560×320 指标卡（活动访问 48.2k → 结账转化 +31% → 周收入 $1.84M）+ 左上 64px 标题，104px 大数字
飞线改为端口到端口：熔铜白热芯 + 两层橙色辉光、亮头彗尾，头部一路掉落按重力下坠的金色火星；生长曲线不对称（起步蓄力、中段最快、进端口前减速）
落点三件事同帧：端口冲击环、卡片描边脉冲提亮、卡片被沿来向"撞"10px 再弹簧回位；同时数字从旧值滚到新值、增量胶囊弹出——数据真的被点亮
节奏：0–18 卡片错峰升起 / 20–46 线 1 / 46 B 点亮 / 62–86 线 2 接力 / 86 C 点亮 / 112–150 hold；hold 段连好的暗铜线上有光包缓慢流动，镜头 1→1.035 极缓推进、焦点从 A 漂向 C
issuesEn: The backdrop was a darkened six-tile FakeDashboard full of 14–20px text and skeleton bars, so you could not tell which metrics the line connected
The line ran centre to centre over the card content and grew with a near-uniform out-cubic, with no sense of being fired across
The landing only flashed a border; the data itself never changed, so the 'metric relationship' stayed decorative
After f86 there were 54 dead frames with nothing moving
changesEn: Ember look (warm black, molten orange, gold) with an attribution map designed for the shot: three 560×320 metric cards (campaign visits 48.2k, checkout conversion +31%, weekly revenue $1.84M) with 104px numbers and a 64px headline top left

Lines now run port to port: a white-hot core with two orange glow layers, a leading head with a comet tail, and gold embers that shed from the head and fall under gravity; growth is asymmetric (wind-up, fastest mid-flight, braking into the port)

Three things happen on the landing frame: a shock ring at the port, a border pulse on the card, and a 10px knock along the arrival direction that springs back; at the same time the number rolls to its new value and a delta pill pops, so the data is visibly switched on

Timing: cards stagger in over 0–18, line 1 20–46, B lights at 46, line 2 relays 62–86, C lights at 86, hold 112–150; during the hold small light packets flow along the settled copper lines and the camera pushes 1 to 1.035 while its focus drifts from A to C
